title: 第23章 刘艺菲：来我家？
content_zh:
“易肥，你是第二个给我打电话的人，我很感动。”谷川说道。

    “你可以叫我英文名吗？”

    刘艺菲总感觉谷川叫她名字的时候怪怪的。

    “怎么？你崇洋媚外？”

    好大一口锅压在小刘的身上，她愤愤不平地骂道：“还钱！”

    谷川不吭声了。

    刘艺菲停了一会，消了消气才又说道：“听说华谊的小王总，和陆穿导演都被抓了，所以打电话问问你有没有被抓。”

    “你是在关心我吗？”

    “不，我是在关心我的6315美元。”刘艺菲认真地说道。

    谷川不满地说道：“扣掉八十。”

    “好，那就扣掉八十。”

    刘艺菲叹了口气，没骗到他那八十块呀，可惜可惜。

    谷川笑着说道：“没事，我人在美国呢，中美没有引渡条款。”

    “额~”

    刘艺菲大吃一惊。

    原来你早就料到这一天了吗？所以才提前跑到美国去的。

    那你跑路的时候，为什么不喊上陆穿导演和小王总？你怎么那么自私？

    “咳咳，开个玩笑而已。”谷川说道：“国内的那些宣发，和我没有一点关系，那都是小王总做的，追究不到我身上。”

    “真的追究不到你身上吗？”刘艺菲小声地说道：“我感觉这次电影的宣发，有一种很熟悉的感觉啊，和《女巫布莱克》好像。”

    “咳咳。”谷川说道：“是小王总非要问我，我才告诉他的，不过在告诉他的时候，还反复劝他不要这样。”

    一切罪过是小王总，谷川冰清玉洁，甚至还劝告人家呢。

    刘艺菲撇了撇嘴。

    你倒是把自己摘出去的快。

    “诱导犯罪也是犯罪。”刘艺菲面无表情地说道。

    “哇哦，你好聪明啊。”谷川调侃道。

    “那当然。”

    刘艺菲扬了扬下巴，有些小得意。

    和谷川认识之后，她就开始对法律感兴趣了。

    谷川说道：“如果你真聪明的话，就不会被我骗6305美元了。”

    “是6315。”

    刘艺菲感觉自己老聪明了。

    她识破了谷川的诡计。

    那个家伙想激怒自己，让自己反应不过来具体的数字是多少，好少还自己十美元。

    要是以前的话，她或许已经上当了。

    但吃一堑长一智，现在的她，不会轻易被骗了。

    “不是已经还了八十块了吗？”谷川说道。
content_en:
"Yi Fei, you are the second person to call me. I am very touched." Tanichuan said.

    "Can you call me by my English name?"

    Liu Yifei always felt that it was weird when Tanichuan called her name.

    "What? Do you worship foreigners?"

    A big pot was placed on Xiao Liu's body, and she cursed angrily: "Pay back the money!"

    Tanichuan remained silent.

    Liu Yifei paused for a while, calmed down before saying again: "I heard that Mr. Wang from Huayi and director Lu Chuan were arrested, so I called to ask if you were arrested."

    "Are you concerned about me?"

    "No, I am concerned about my $6,315." Liu Yifei said seriously.

    Tanichuan said dissatisfiedly: "Eighty points will be deducted."

    "Okay, then eighty will be deducted."

    Liu Yifei sighed, it was a pity that she didn't get the eighty yuan from him.

    Tanigawa smiled and said, "It's okay. I'm in the United States. There are no extradition clauses between China and the United States."

    "Uh~"

    Liu Yifei was shocked.

    So you had expected this day? That’s why I ran to the United States in advance.

    Then when you were running away, why didn't you call Director Lu Chuan and Mr. Wang? Why are you so selfish?

    "Ahem, it's just a joke." Tanichuan said: "The publicity in the country has nothing to do with me. It was all done by Mr. Wang and cannot be traced to me."

    "Is it true that we can't be traced to you?" Liu Yifei said in a low voice: "I feel that the announcement of the movie this time has a very familiar feeling, similar to "Black Witch"."

    "Ahem." Tanichuan said, "I told him because Mr. Wang insisted on asking me, but when I told him, I repeatedly advised him not to do this."

    Mr. Wang is responsible for all the crimes. Gu Chuan is pure and pure, and he even gives advice to others.

    Liu Yifei curled her lips.

    You can take it out quickly.

    "Inducing a crime is also a crime." Liu Yifei said expressionlessly.

    "Wow, you are so smart." Tanichuan teased.

    "Of course."

    Liu Yifei raised her chin, feeling a little proud.

    After meeting Tanichuan, she became interested in law.

    Tanichuan said: "If you were really smart, you wouldn't have been defrauded of $6,305 by me."

    "It's 6315."

    Liu Yifei feels that she is getting smarter.

    She saw through Tanichuan's trick.

    The guy wanted to irritate himself so that he couldn't react to the specific number, so he could pay himself back ten dollars.

    If it had been before, she might have been fooled.

    But she gained wisdom after every experience, and now she will not be easily deceived.

    "Didn't you already pay back 80 yuan?" Tanichuan said.
title_en: Chapter 23 Liu Yifei: Come to my house?
